name: kubernetes-manager
description: Codex workflow support and callable tools for Kubernetes project integration, workload operations, and managed cluster administration.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate projects, operate workloads, and administer Kubernetes clusters.
interface.longDescription: Adds a Codex skill, callable MCP tools, and helper scripts for assessing a project, generating Kubernetes manifests, checking Docker Desktop Kubernetes, connecting to OKE or Azure AKS clusters, administering cluster resources and node pools, validating resources, and applying workloads through kubectl.
defaultPrompt: Use Kubernetes Manager to integrate this project with Kubernetes.
Check whether Docker Desktop Kubernetes is ready for local development.
Call Kubernetes Manager tools for cluster administration.
